## Last commit: sanitised Junos configuration excerpt. All credentials are FAKE
## and the trailing "## rule:" annotation names the redaction rule id
## expected to catch it (see junos.expect.json).
version 23.4R1.9;
system {
    host-name core-rtr-02;
    root-authentication {
        encrypted-password "$6$FAKEsalt$junosRootSha512HashAbCdEfGhIjKl"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-encrypted-password
    }
    login {
        user admin {
            uid 2000;
            class super-user;
            authentication {
                encrypted-password "$1$FAKEsalt$junosAdminMd5Hash1234"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-encrypted-password
            }
        }
        user netops {
            uid 2001;
            class read-only;
            authentication {
                encrypted-password "$5$FAKEsalt$junosNetopsSha256Hash5678"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-encrypted-password
            }
        }
    }
    tacplus-server {
        10.20.30.40 {
            secret "$9$FAKEjunosTacplusSecretAbCdEf"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-secret-data
            source-address 10.255.0.2;
        }
    }
    radius-server {
        10.20.30.41 secret "$9$FAKEjunosRadiusSecretGhIjKl"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-secret-data
    }
    ntp {
        authentication-key 1 type md5 value "$9$FAKEjunosNtpKeyMnOpQr"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-secret-data
    }
}
interfaces {
    ge-0/0/0 {
        description "uplink to core-rtr-01";
        unit 0 {
            family inet {
                address 192.0.2.5/30;
            }
        }
    }
}
protocols {
    bgp {
        group EBGP-PEERS {
            type external;
            neighbor 192.0.2.6 {
                authentication-key "$9$FAKEjunosBgpKeyStUvWx"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-secret-data
                peer-as 65001;
            }
        }
    }
    ospf {
        area 0.0.0.0 {
            interface ge-0/0/0.0 {
                authentication {
                    md5 1 key "$9$FAKEjunosOspfMd5KeyYzAbCd"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: junos-secret-data
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
security {
    ike {
        policy IKE-POL-BRANCH {
            mode main;
            pre-shared-key ascii-text "$9$FAKEjunosIkePskEfGhIj"; ## SECRET-DATA  ## rule: ike-pre-shared-key
        }
    }
}
snmp {
    community FAKEjunosRoCommunity {  ## rule: generic-keyword
        authorization read-only;
    }
}
## The same device in "show configuration | display set" form, where the
## SECRET-DATA marker is absent and the $9$ hash itself must be recognised.
set system login user svc-backup authentication encrypted-password "$5$FAKEsalt$junosSvcBackupHashKlMnOp"  ## rule: junos-encrypted-password
set protocols bgp group EBGP-PEERS neighbor 192.0.2.10 authentication-key "$9$FAKEjunosSetFormatBgpKeyQrSt"  ## rule: junos-9-hash
set system radius-server 10.20.30.42 secret "$9$FAKEjunosSetFormatRadiusUvWx"  ## rule: junos-9-hash
